title: Most firms don't need more software
summary: They need the software they have to work the way they do. What Spatacco Analytics works on, and who for.

blocks.text: We work with financial advisors and small business owners on three things: the CRM they already pay for, the website that should be winning them clients, and the data sitting between the two.
Most firms don't need more software. They need the software they have to work the way they do.
More here soon on what we're building and what we're seeing in the field.
